answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 156252 Country: Pakistan Title: When we use the term Islam then is it right to say that it solely means Quranic injunctions? Question: When we use the term Islam then is it right to say that it solely means Quranic injunctions? Answer ID: 156252 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 290/226/B=2/1439) All the commandments mentioned therein the Holy Quran and Hadith are Islamic teachings. It is not so that only the Quranic commandments are Islamic teachings. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
